name: baton
description: Baton — shortcuts for the whole project. The app lives in frontend/ (React) and backend/ (FastAPI).

scripts.loadtest:llm: cd backend && uv run --group loadtest python ../loadtest/fake_llm.py
scripts.loadtest:api: cd backend && uv run --group loadtest python ../loadtest/run_api.py
scripts.loadtest:setup: cd backend && uv run --group loadtest python ../loadtest/setup_keycloak.py
scripts.loadtest: cd backend && uv run --group loadtest locust -f ../loadtest/locustfile.py --host http://127.0.0.1:8799
scripts.loadtest:ci: cd backend && uv run --group loadtest locust -f ../loadtest/locustfile.py --host http://127.0.0.1:8799 --headless -u 150 -r 10 -t 3m --csv ../loadtest/results/run --html ../loadtest/results/report.html
scripts.vault:seed: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker-compose.yml run --rm -e VAULT_SEED=force vault-init
scripts.app:logs: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker-compose.yml --profile app logs -f --tail=100 api web
scripts.app:ingest: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker-compose.yml --profile tools run --rm ingest
